title: Iatridis 1999 degenerated AF equilibrium shear modulus vs shear strain (35 kPa)

quantity.name: equilibrium shear modulus G_eq
quantity.definition: tau_eq / gamma after 900 s relaxation at each shear strain, 35 kPa axial compression

source.authors: Iatridis JC, Kumar S, Foster RJ, Weidenbaum M, Mow VC
source.sample: 13 axially oriented AF cylinders from 13 L3-L4 discs: 7 nondegenerated, 6 degenerated

protocol.summary: Axially oriented AF cylinders tested in torsional shear (parallel plates) under axial compressive stress 17.5, 25 and 35 kPa; frequency sweeps 0.1-100 rad/s at 0.05 rad; strain sweeps 0.005-0.15 rad at 5 rad/s (35 kPa); static stress relaxation at 0.02-0.15 rad (900 s per step, 35 kPa) giving equilibrium shear stress tau_eq and G_eq = tau_eq / gamma.
how_to_simulate: Model an axial AF cylinder between platens under the stated axial compressive stress
Apply torsion (dynamic: sinusoidal; static: step and hold 900 s)
Report |G*| (dynamic) or G_eq = tau_eq/gamma at the sample periphery

extraction.check_notes: Digitised from 200-dpi render with marker detection / visual reading against axis ticks; paper reports these only in figures (OCR text garbled). Consistent with text: G_eq range 20-150 kPa. Calibration 2.48 px/kPa on 200-dpi crop (x2 zoom).

pass_rule.rule: model curve inside the measured corridor (mean +/- 1 SD or min-max) over the tested range
